subject: Governed swap runbook — dataset & promptpack provisioning (MAP draft)
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Jack Turner <jack@olive-retail.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Governed swap runbook — dataset & promptpack provisioning (MAP draft)

Jack —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Attached is a first-pass MAP and a promptpack manifest that outlines the test cases Olive will share for our 4-week evaluation. High level summary / asks: 

- Scope: prompt packs, a 25k-row "sample subset" of anonymized customer support transcripts, and a small probe dataset for hallucination tests.
- Environment: ephemeral sandbox (private VPC) with tokenized access, read-only S3 bucket for sample data, and a private model endpoint in our staging cluster.
- Usage constraints: data retention capped at 7 days in staging; no exporting of embeddings or raw transcripts outside the sandbox; outputs may be logged for acceptance criteria but logs are redacted.
- Security: we will provide SOC 2 Type II and encryption-at-rest docs; Olive will provide the signed DPA/MPA for the handoff.
- Escrow / transfer: promptpack delivered via encrypted presigned link + one-time escrow code; dataset files delivered to a shared S3 with object-level ACLs.
- Acceptance: we propose three acceptance gates (ingest verification, functional correctness on probe suite, and performance thresholds) with a final close meeting in week 4.

Timeline (proposed):
Week 0 (this week) — finalize scope & sign MPA/DPA
Week 1 — provision sandbox, exchange promptpack + sample subset
Week 2 — run baseline tests & iterate on prompt tweaks
Week 3 — final acceptance tests; collect metrics
Week 4 — close meeting, return/takedown schedule begins (7-day retention confirmed)

I attached a draft MAP and the promptpack manifest. Can you confirm: 1) Olive OK with 7-day retention in staging, 2) any legal requirements for the escrow (preferred: DocuSign acknowledgement + one-time key), and 3) who should be on the kickoff call?

If that all looks reasonable I’ll turn this into a signable MAP and loop in Legal to start the DPA.

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Sr. Strategic Partnerships | Redwood Inference
aomi.feldman@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123
Redwood Inference

Attachments: NAOMI_MAP_Draft_v1.pdf; promptpack_manifest.csv

From: Jack Turner <jack@olive-retail.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Olive Retail Legal <legal@olive-retail.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Governed swap runbook — dataset & promptpack provisioning (MAP draft)

Thanks Naomi — appreciate the clear plan. A few quick points from our side: 

- Retention: can we extend staging retention to 14 days instead of 7? Our analysts may need an extra week to run longitudinal checks. If 14 days is a hard no, can we agree to a one-time 7-day retention for the trial and extend for a follow-up pilot?
- Escrow: Legal prefers the promptpack be delivered under a basic MPA + DPA and wants the escrow key workflow logged (audit trail + signer identity). DocuSign is fine.
- Export controls: Olive will not permit raw transcript exports; however, sanitized embeddings export for downstream analytics might be useful — can we discuss a gated export flow with approval?

We can join a kickoff on Friday (PST) — propose myself and our head of ML, Priya Shah (priya.shah@olive-retail.com).

Jack
Head of Product, Olive Retail
jack@olive-retail.com | +1 (212) 555-0189

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 04 Nov 2026 08:22:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Governed swap runbook — dataset & promptpack provisioning (MAP draft)

Folks — forwarding Jack's reply. Two asks for our ops/legal track: 1) can we accept 14-day retention as an exception for Olive's initial trial? 2) what gating do we need to support a filtered embedding export (audit + owner approval)?

Action items I propose: 
- Kimberly: can your infra team provision the ephemeral VPC sandbox with a 14-day retention toggle and generate the presigned encrypted link flow? Add a checklist for object lifecycle rules (auto-delete) and audit logging to the runbook.
- Markus: loop in Legal to prep a slim DPA/MPA with the escrow signer clause and an explicit no-raw-export clause; include an approval workflow for any embedding exports.
- I’ll prepare the kickoff invite and the acceptance criteria sheet (I attached a mutual_action_plan.xlsx with the gates).

Let’s sync tomorrow 10am PST for 20 minutes to confirm owners.

Naomi

On Wed, Nov 4, 2026 at 08:40 AM Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Naomi / Markus —
>
> We can stand up the ephemeral VPC sandbox and the S3 object lane. Notes from infra: 
> - Provisioning: 24–48 hours to create the sandbox, separate subnet, and ephemeral token service.
> - Retention: we can support a configurable retention window; default is 7 days but we can enable 14 days for this customer as a one-time parameter on the sandbox resource. Lifecycle rule will auto-delete objects after TTL.
> - Escrow/transfer: we will deliver the promptpack via an encrypted presigned URL (TLS + AES-256 at rest). For escrow, we will coordinate DocuSign and store the one-time code in HashiVault; access keys will be time-limited.
> - Export controls: embeddings export will be blocked by default; we can implement a gated export that requires: (a) legal approval ticket, (b) signed export request, (c) audit snapshot retained for 90 days.
>
> I’ve created a short JIRA ticket to track infra tasks: ENGINF-762 (link in MAP). I’ll add estimated ETA and owners there.
>
> If legal signs off on the gated export workflow we can include it in the MAP.
>
> -Kimberly
> Director, Cloud Ops | Redwood Inference
> kimberly.park@redwood.ai
>

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 06 Nov 2026 09:12:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Governed swap runbook — dataset & promptpack provisioning (MAP draft)

Naomi / Kimberly —

Legal can produce a slim DPA and an MPA addendum that documents the escrow signer and the audit logging requirements. Two legal notes to call out: 
1) Embeddings: the MPA must list "embeddings" explicitly in the no-export clause if Olive does not want them to leave the sandbox. If Olive wants a gated export we will need a signed export addendum and a named approver from Olive.
2) Data destruction: the MPA should have a destruction attestation step — we will provide a signed certificate when the sandbox is torn down.

I’ll draft language and circulate a redline by EOD.

-Markus
General Counsel | Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.ai

From: Jack Turner <jack@olive-retail.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@olive-retail.com>, Olive Retail Legal <legal@olive-retail.com>
Date: Fri, 06 Nov 2026 13:47:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Governed swap runbook — dataset & promptpack provisioning (MAP draft)

Naomi — all sounds good. Olive confirms: 
- We accept the one-time 14-day retention for the initial trial.
- We will sign the slim DPA/MPA with the escrow clause and provide a named approver for any embeddings export (Priya Shah).
- Kickoff: Friday 11/06 at 2pm PST — myself and Priya will join. Please send calendar invite.

Looking forward to getting started.

Jack
Head of Product, Olive Retail
jack@olive-retail.com | +1 (212) 555-0189
